title: dryas octopetala subsp. dasypetala
intro: Dryas octopetala subsp. dasypetala, commonly known as Mountain Avens, is a flowering plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of aiding in the relief of colds, flu, and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Avens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, combat viral infections, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
